Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

$90,000-$130,000

title: Estimator
description:
Civils Estimator

  • Annual Salary: up to Â£75,000 per annum + benefits
  • Location: Warrington, North-West of England
  • Job Type: Full-time


Reed Recruitment are delighted to be recruiting for one of the UKâs leading multi-discipline Civil Engineering and Building contractors, for a Civils Estimator. This role offers a fantastic opportunity for career development and progression within a dynamic team.


Day-to-day of the role:

  • Provide a comprehensive estimating service, controlling either an assigned project or a portfolio of projects.
  • Identify potential risks from initial analysis of project documentation.
  • Prepare tender estimates from first principles using Conquest estimating software, drawing on previous experience and knowledge of techniques, outputs, subcontractor quotations, and material prices unique to each tender.
  • Conduct site visits as required for the tender to ascertain site-specific complexities, access requirements, etc.
  • Lead and participate in discussions and negotiations with suppliers and subcontractors during the tender process.
  • Engage in pre-tender discussions/sign-off with senior colleagues.
  • Attend and contribute to pre/post-tender meetings with clients' designated personnel.
  • Conduct handover meetings with contract and commercial colleagues to ensure all elements of the tender process and procedures are communicated, and project complexities are fully understood by all parties prior to the signing of the contract.
  • Stay updated on inflation, exchange rates, and projected timescale costs.
  • Obtain feedback from site teams on estimating adequacy and current costs.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • HND/C in Civil Engineering.
  • At least two years of previous experience working in an Estimating Department.
  • Thorough understanding of construction techniques, outputs, and the relationship between costs from these and the market values and how this is utilised in tendering.
  • Forming bills of quantities from drawings take-offs, either by hand or from Estimating software.
  • Ability to prioritise, manage, and coordinate multiple tender opportunities in a constantly changing environment with minimal supervision.
  • High level of PC literacy with working knowledge of Conquest Series Q, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word & Project software.


Desirable:

  • BEng / BSc in Civil Engineering.
  • CSCS Card.
  • Eagerness to learn from experienced members of the company to further understanding.
  • Knowledge and experience of CESMM, SMM Methods of Measurement, production of activity schedules, and population of contract sum analyses.
  • Ability to work independently utilising several standard forms of contract such as NEC/JCT and bespoke contracts.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Long-term career opportunities and excellent potential for future development and progression.
  • Opportunity to work with a leading company in the industry.


To apply for the Civils Estimator position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this position.

title: Butcher
description:
Company Overview


The Butcher Shoppe (TBS) is one of the largest meat processors in Ontario located in the Toronto area. Our meats are carefully selected for quality and consistency to achieve the highest standards for our customers. Through the timely heritage of artisanal butchery, over 100,000 lbs of meat are processed daily and fulfilled by a team of butchers who convert fresh meat to custom specifications. Our distribution network uses a fleet 45 company trucks that make over 1,000 deliveries every day to customers across Ontario including premier hotels, casinos, event venues, restaurants, and foodservice establishments. TBS also manages a complex supply chain that spans 4 continents. Our people-first philosophy has provided a strong foundation for growth. This has allowed us to expand while still staying true to our heritage of artisanal butchery. Over the past 40 years, we have grown steadily to meet the demands of the foodservice industry and now, direct-to-consumer through e-commerce and a full-service onsite Retail store.

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Opened in 2008, Four Seasons Hotel Macao has become a coveted destination for both business and leisure travelers who seek exceptional and personalized services. Its numerous awards and satisfied customers attest to its excellence. In October 2020, Four Seasons Hotel Macao introduced The Grand Suites, an all-suite tower that took the concept of luxury and bespoke services to new heights. With the addition of 289 suites, the Hotel's room count increased to a combined total of 649 keys, making it the largest property within the Four Seasons group. About The Role

The Bell Captain is responsible for assisting guest with their arrival and departure experience; makes necessary deliveries to and pick up from guest rooms, transports guests and hotel packages, faxes, envelopes and parcels.   • Greet guests upon arrival and departure with a friendly and professional demeanor
  • Provide information about the hotel facilities, local attractions, and services
  • Conduct periodic inventory checks on luggage tags, luggage stored and miscellaneous
  • Coordinate with other departments to fulfill guest requests and needs
  • Handle guest inquiries and complaints promptly and professionally
  • Assist with transportation arrangements, including Taxi, Shuttle and Limousine services

What You Bring

  • Reading, writing and oral proficiency in Cantonese, Mandarin and English
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Committed to achieving high levels of service excellence and guest contentment.
  • 1-2 years luxury hotel experience as Bell Attendant or Bell Captain
  • Knowledge of the local area and attractions is a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package
  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities
  • Employee Discount for stays at any Four Seasons worldwide
  • Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms
  • Complimentary Employee Meals

Schedule & Hours

  • 48 Hours weekly
  • Work on shift

Pre-arrival checks include: air filters, shower heads, bathroom hardware, kitchen appliances, HVAC functionality, light fixtures, bulbs, fans, internet/TV services, septic systems, door locks, propane levels, plumbing, grills, and any reported issues.

The Residential Technician is a vital part of ensuring that homes and Club facilities meet the highest standards for members and guests. This position contributes directly to the quality of the homeowner experience by preserving property integrity and delivering prompt, professional service.

description:
About This Role:

 

We are looking for an enthusiastic, customer-obsessed Studio Sales Associate to join our team in our Lincoln Park studio location. You will be responsible for creating an exceptional piercing and shopping experience for our customers in a genuine and enthusiastic manner, supporting the team on the weekends. This position involves assisting customers with ear piercings, providing product recommendations, and ensuring the studio maintains Rowanâs high standards of cleanliness and safety. Your responsibility is to infuse the Rowan experience, bring brand awareness, product knowledge and the art of ear stacking to life, through engaging customer interactions. Ideal Availability:

\n

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we rarely outsource recruitment.

title: Quantity Surveyor
description:
Job Description â Quantity Surveyor (QS Engineer)Position

Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer â Civil Construction

Project: Commercial Hotel Construction Project

Location: Vijayawada / Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh

Site: Daspalla Project Site

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in civil/building construction to join the project team for a commercial hotel construction project in Vijayawada/Amaravati.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in quantity estimation, BOQ preparation, rate analysis, measurement, subcontractor billing, client billing, material reconciliation and cost control.

Candidates with experience in commercial buildings, hotels, high-rise buildings or large-scale building projects will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review BOQs, quantity take-offs and estimates for civil and finishing works.
  • Prepare detailed quantity calculations from architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
  • Conduct regular site measurements and maintain accurate measurement records.
  • Prepare and verify contractor/subcontractor bills based on actual site measurements.
  • Review subcontractor RA bills, work orders, measurements and supporting documents.
  • Prepare client bills / RA bills and ensure timely submission.
  • Carry out rate analysis for various civil, structural and finishing items.
  • Monitor project quantities against the BOQ and identify variations.
  • Prepare and maintain variation statements, extra items and deviation statements.
  • Track project costs and assist in maintaining effective cost control.
  • Reconcile quantities of key materials such as cement, steel, concrete and other construction materials.
  • Coordinate with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, Planning Team, Purchase Team, Accounts Team and subcontractors.
  • Check drawings and specifications to identify quantity/cost implications before execution.
  • Maintain proper documentation of measurements, bills, work orders, quotations and quantity records.
  • Assist in preparing project cost forecasts and quantity/progress reports.
  • Support commercial negotiations with subcontractors and vendors when required.
  • Ensure that all billing and measurement documentation is accurate and submitted within project timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Quantity Surveyor / QS Engineer in civil/building construction.
  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, quantity take-off, measurements and billing.
  • Good understanding of civil construction drawings and specifications.
  • Experience in subcontractor billing and client billing.
  • Strong knowledge of rate analysis and cost estimation.
  • Experience handling variation orders, extra items and reconciliation statements.
  • Good knowledge of Excel and quantity/billing-related software.
  • Ability to independently handle QS activities at a project site.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.

title: Senior Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst
description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst. 

 

About RainFocus

 

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one.

\n


Key Responsibilities:
Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.
 
Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.
 
Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.
 
Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.
 
Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.
 
Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.
 
Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.
 
Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.
 
Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.
 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.
 
Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.
 
Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress.
Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements.


Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable.

6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field.

In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others).

Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist.

Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable.

Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus.

Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.


Personal Characteristics:

Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to adapt to change and learn quickly.

Passion for security and privacy.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

 

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

Responsible for day-to-day SRO completion, downstream and upstream SNR maintenance and repair, troubleshooting and repair of all aspects of the HFC network from the node to the end of line, HFC (Hybrid Fibre Coaxial) node activation. RF alignment, node power supply troubleshooting, Outside Plant Construction (consisting of Aerial and Underground infrastructure), including new builds to support HFC plant extensions, FTTH Developments and Commercial Installations, installation and activation of new Outside Plant passive and active devices, construction of underground chambers inclusive of underground enclosures. Qualifications

  • Minimum of an Associate Degree or Certification in Construction, HFC or Fiber.

title: (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d)
description:
Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche.

Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sie als (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d).


Was Sie bei uns bewegen:

  • Permanente Durchführung von Passform- und Qualitätskontrollen

  • Produktionsfreigabe anhand Mustertypen

  • Kontinuierlicher Austausch innerhalb des Produktmanagements und mit den internationalen Produktionsstätten

Was uns ausmacht:

  • Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur.

  • Alles, was Sie zum Arbeiten benötigen: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung.

  • Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Sie gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle und der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens können Sie Ihr Berufsleben optimal an ihr Privatleben anpassen.

  • Mit uns profitieren Sie von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern über das Portal corporate Benefits.

  • Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine.

  • Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Ihr Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße.

  • Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de.

  • Wir feiern Erfolg und Gemeinschaft: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Team-Events und Firmenfeiern sind ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur.



Was Sie ausmacht:

  • Schuhgröße 37, Fußlänge 231 – 236 mm, durchschnittliche Fuß- und Wadenform

  • Großes Interesse an Mode und Schuhen sowie ein starkes Bewusstsein für die Qualität von Materialien und deren Verarbeitung

  • Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit gepaart mit guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung wünschenswert; gerne auch Quereinsteiger

  • Hohes Engagement

  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen

Sie sind ein verantwortungsbewusster und äußerst engagierter Teamplayer und schätzen die konstruktive Zusammenarbeit? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

IHR KONTAKT

Gülizar Yüsün

Personalmanagement

title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) | Health & Beauty Scale-up
description:
MY HEALTH & BEAUTY ist Deutschlands erstes Health&Beauty-Startup mit dem Ziel, hochwertige ästhetische Medizin und moderne Longevity-Anwendungen für eine breite Zielgruppe zugänglich, unkompliziert, bezahlbar und flächendeckend verfügbar zu machen.

Innerhalb von nur drei Jahren sind wir auf 10 Standorte und mehr als 50.000 Kunden gewachsen. Damit gehören wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmen im Bereich der ästhetischen Medizin in Deutschland.

Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

In den kommenden Jahren wollen wir unseren Wachstumskurs noch deutlich beschleunigen und MY HEALTH&BEAUTY als eine der führenden Marken für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity etablieren.

Unser Erfolgsmodell basiert auf einem klaren Anspruch: hohe medizinische Qualität ohne Kompromisse für Alle zugänglich

Unsere Behandlungen werden ausschließlich von Ärzten durchgeführt. Wir arbeiten mit den hochwertigsten Produkten führender Hersteller und setzen auf standardisierte Prozesse, intensive Schulungen und eine konsequent hohe Behandlungs- und Servicequalität.

Unser Ziel ist nicht der kurzfristige "Verkauf" einzelner Behandlungen, sondern der Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch Qualität, Vertrauen und ein konstant exzellentes Kundenerlebnis.

Der Markt für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity wächst sehr stark. Gleichzeitig verändern sich die Erwartungen der Kunden: Behandlungen sollen professioneller, zugänglicher und selbstverständlicher werden.

Genau diese Entwicklung treiben wir aktiv voran.

Deine Mission

Für die nächste Phase unseres Wachstums suchen wir einen Head of Operations, der die operative Entwicklung unserer HEALTH&BEAUTY Lounges verantwortet und gemeinsam mit uns die Grundlage für die nächsten 10, 20 und oder 100 Standorte schafft.

Aufgaben

Deine Verantwortung

Du trägst die operative Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Standorte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung unsere Operations kontinuierlich weiter.

Leadership & People

Du führst unsere operativen Kollegen und späteren Führungskräfte und sorgst dafür, dass Führung nicht nur auf dem Papier stattfindet, sondern im täglichen Geschäft spürbar ist.

Du entwickelst Mitarbeiter und Führungskräfte weiter, gibst klares Feedback und schaffst eindeutige Verantwortlichkeiten.

Du erkennst Leistungsträger frühzeitig und entwickelst sie weiter.

Genauso konsequent gehst du mit Underperformance um.

Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Recruiting Team dafür, dass unsere Standorte jederzeit mit den richtigen Menschen besetzt sind und wir auch bei starkem Wachstum oder Ausfällen unsere personellen Standards halten.

Training & Development

Du entwickelst strukturierte Trainings- und Weiterbildungsprogramme für unsere Teams.

Du führst Trainings selbst durch und entwickelst gleichzeitig Strukturen, mit denen Wissen innerhalb der Organisation skalierbar weitergegeben werden kann.

Du etablierst klare Standards für Onboarding, Führung, Verkauf, Kundenservice und operative Abläufe.

Dabei misst du nicht nur, ob Trainings stattgefunden haben, sondern ob sie tatsächlich zu besserer Performance führen.

Operational Excellence

Du analysierst sämtliche operativen Prozesse unseres Unternehmens und stellst sie kontinuierlich infrage.

Was funktioniert, wird standardisiert.

Was nicht funktioniert, wird verändert.

Was unnötig kompliziert ist, wird vereinfacht.

Du entwickelst SOPs, Verantwortlichkeiten und Prozesse, die für jeden Standort klar verständlich und reproduzierbar sind.

Dein Anspruch ist, dass ein Kunde unabhängig vom Standort ein konstant hohes MY-HEALTH-&-BEAUTY-Erlebnis erhält.

Performance & KPIs

Du steuerst Operations anhand von Zahlen und nicht anhand von Bauchgefühl.

Du definierst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die relevanten operativen KPIs und stellst sicher, dass diese transparent, verstanden und konsequent gesteuert werden.

Dazu gehören insbesondere Produktivität, Personaleinsatz, Auslastung, Umsatzperformance, Kundenbindung, Servicequalität und operative Effizienz.

Wenn ein Standort seine Ziele verfehlt, analysierst du nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern findest heraus, warum.

Anschließend entwickelst du konkrete Maßnahmen, definierst Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst deren Umsetzung sicher.

Customer Experience & Qualitätsanspruch

Wir wollen nicht durchschnittlich gut sein.

Unser Anspruch ist ein außergewöhnlich hohes Niveau in jedem einzelnen Standort.

Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Standards hinsichtlich Kundenservice, Organisation, Sauberkeit, Auftreten, Kommunikation und operativer Qualität konsequent eingehalten werden.

Du erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und greifst ein, bevor aus kleinen Problemen strukturelle Probleme werden.

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen

Diese Position ist bewusst nicht für jeden geeignet.

Wir suchen einen leistungsorientierten Menschen mit einem sehr hohen eigenen Anspruch.

Du solltest bereits bewiesen haben, dass du Menschen führen, operative Strukturen verbessern und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernehmen kannst.

Was du zwingend mitbringen solltest

Mehrjährige relevante Führungserfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen operativen Organisation.

Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung größerer Teams und mehrerer Führungsebenen.

Idealerweise hast du bereits Verantwortung für mehrere Standorte oder dezentrale operative Einheiten getragen.

Du hast Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeiter nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern tatsächlich zu entwickeln, zu motivieren und leistungsfähiger zu machen.

Du kannst professionelle Trainingskonzepte entwickeln und bist gleichzeitig stark genug in Kommunikation und Auftreten, diese Trainings selbst durchzuführen.

Du bist zahlengetrieben und kannst aus KPIs konkrete operative Entscheidungen ableiten.

Du hast bereits Prozesse aufgebaut oder grundlegend verbessert und kannst konkrete Beispiele nennen, bei denen deine Arbeit messbar zu besseren Ergebnissen geführt hat.

Du kannst gleichzeitig strategisch und extrem hands-on arbeiten.

Du kommunizierst klar, direkt und verbindlich und scheust dich nicht davor, auch unangenehme Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsgefühl und wartest bei Problemen nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Wir suchen keine Person, die möglichst viele Aufgaben delegiert und Operations hauptsächlich aus Meetings und Reports heraus steuert.

Wir suchen jemanden, der das Unternehmen wirklich verstehen will.

Jemanden, der regelmäßig in unseren Standorten präsent ist.

Der mit Mitarbeitern spricht.

Der Kunden beobachtet.

Der Prozesse selbst durchläuft.

Der Probleme sieht, bevor sie in einem Dashboard auftauchen.

Und der anschließend Strukturen schafft, damit diese Probleme dauerhaft gelöst werden.

Du solltest einen außergewöhnlich hohen Anspruch an Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Umsetzung haben.

Wir arbeiten in einem stark wachsenden Unternehmen. Damit gehen Veränderung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und Phasen außergewöhnlicher Belastung einher.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung nicht an seiner Stellenbeschreibung oder an der Uhr festmacht. Wenn eine wichtige Standorteröffnung ansteht, ein Team Unterstützung benötigt oder ein operatives Problem gelöst werden muss, erwarten wir Ownership und die Bereitschaft, die Extrameile zu gehen.

Was für uns zählt, sind Ergebnisse.

Dein Mindset

Du denkst unternehmerisch.

Du willst gestalten statt verwalten.

Du stellst hohe Anforderungen an dich selbst und an dein Team.

Du kannst Menschen begeistern, aber genauso klare Grenzen setzen.

Du bist extrem lösungsorientiert.

Du suchst bei Problemen nicht nach Erklärungen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert, sondern nach einem nachhaltigen Weg, es zu lösen.

Du kannst Prioritäten setzen und auch unter Druck klar entscheiden.

Du hast keine Angst vor Verantwortung.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich keinen Verwalter bestehender Strukturen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Strukturen hinterfragt, Schwachstellen erkennt, Lösungen entwickelt und diese konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der strategisch denken kann, aber genauso selbstverständlich selbst vor Ort ist, mit Teams arbeitet, Trainings durchführt, Probleme löst und Verantwortung übernimmt.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

Eine Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die weitere Entwicklung und Skalierung von MY HEALTH&BEAUTY.

Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung mit attraktivem Fixgehalt und leistungsabhängigem Bonus.

Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.

Ein Unternehmen mit hoher Geschwindigkeit, ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und der Möglichkeit, Ergebnisse unmittelbar sichtbar zu machen.

Keine Konzernbürokratie und keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Ideen können schnell entschieden und umgesetzt werden.

Und vor allem: eine Rolle, in der du wirklich etwas aufbauen kannst, anstatt lediglich einen bestehenden Betrieb zu verwalten.

Wenn du dich darin wiederfindest und bereits nachweislich auf einem hohen Niveau gearbeitet hast, möchten wir dich gerne kennenlernen.

title: Quereinstieg Vertrieb (w/m/d) – Terminierung
description:
FIXING THE PLANET BY MAKING HOMES CARBON-FREE!

Jeden Tag melden sich bei uns Eigenheimbesitzer, die ihr Haus elektrifizieren wollen — Wärmepumpe, PV, oft beides. Sie fragen nicht ob, sie fragen wann und mit wem. Wir haben gerade so viele Interessenten, dass wir kurzfristig Unterstützung suchen. Wenn Du sofort kannst: umso besser. Wenn Du drei Monate Kündigungsfrist hast: bewirb Dich trotzdem, wir stellen laufend ein.

Was das für Dich heißt

  • Keine Kaltakquise. Jeder, den Du anrufst, hat sich vorher selbst bei uns gemeldet
  • 60.000 € Zielgehalt im ersten Jahr, davon 33.000 € Grundgehalt. Deine Provision hängt an stattgefundenen Terminen und den Abschlüssen, die daraus entstehen — beides zählt für Dich
  • Garantieprovision in den Monaten 1 bis 3, damit Du in Ruhe ankommst
  • Der Weg zum Sales Manager steht offen, und die Kriterien sind klar: Zielerreichung, gute Booking-Rate, saubere Pipeline. Wie schnell Du da bist, hängt an Dir
  • Zwei Tage Homeoffice, drei Tage Büro. Am Anfang mehr Büro, weil Coaching am Hörer nur live funktioniert

Dein Spielfeld

  • Du rufst Interessenten an, oft innerhalb weniger Minuten nach ihrer Anfrage — Schnelligkeit ist bei uns der größte Hebel
  • Du klärst in wenigen Minuten, was für dieses Haus überhaupt in Frage kommt: Bestand, Förderung, Budget, wer mitentscheidet — und wie dringend es ist
  • Du machst daraus einen verbindlichen Videotermin mit einem unserer Sales Manager und sorgst dafür, dass der auch wahrgenommen wird
  • Du übergibst sauber: Was weiß der Kunde, was will er, worauf muss unser Sales Management achten
  • Du pflegst Deine Pipeline selbst in HubSpot

Ehrlich dazu: Das ist ein Telefonjob mit hoher Schlagzahl. Nicht jeder geht ran, nicht jeder will sofort einen Termin. Wer damit umgehen kann, verdient hier deutlich mehr als im Kundenservice — und lernt Vertrieb an einem Produkt, das die Leute wirklich wollen.

So passt du in's Team

  • Du hast schon mit Kunden telefoniert — im Kundenservice, im Callcenter, in der Terminierung, im Vertrieb. Aus welcher Branche, ist uns egal
  • Du kannst zuhören und trotzdem zum Punkt kommen. Am Telefon merkt man das in den ersten zwanzig Sekunden
  • Du dokumentierst, was Du besprochen hast, statt es im Kopf zu behalten
  • Du willst dahin, wo mehr für Dich drin ist — und weißt, dass Provision bedeutet, dass Du dafür etwas tun musst

Vertriebserfahrung im engeren Sinn brauchst Du nicht. Wärmepumpen und Förderprogramme bringen wir Dir bei, das ist unser Job. Wer schon Sanierungs- oder Energiethemen kennt, hat einen Vorsprung, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Spreeblick statt Hinterhof: unser Büro liegt direkt am Wasser, mitten in Kreuzberg
  • Zwei Remote-Tage pro Woche, der Rest live mit dem Team
  • Ein Learning-Budget, das auf Deine Entwicklung einzahlt – fachlich oder querbeet
  • Urban Sports Club, Jobticket, Kita-Zuschuss – je nach dem, was in Deinem Leben gerade zählt
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Du begleitest Menschen dabei, ihre Häuser nachhaltiger zu machen und leistest so einen echten Beitrag - Energiewende zum anfassen

Bewirb Dich

Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird, sondern wie und mit wem. Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater begleiten wir energetische Sanierungen ganzheitlich — von der ersten Frage bis zur installierten Wärmepumpe oder PV-Anlage. Über 40 Millionen Euro Funding, 80 Mitarbeitende, ein Markt, der gerade erst losgeht.

Kathi (Talent Acquisition Partner) ist Deine Ansprechpartnerin für diese Rolle. Lebenslauf reicht, kein Anschreiben. Wenn Du ein paar echte Sätze über Dich ergänzen willst, gerne — lieber als ein durchformuliertes Anschreiben.

  • Company & Founder Marketing: Own and grow Mercura's company and founder LinkedIn presence. Turn what happens inside Mercura into content that reaches prospective customers, exceptional candidates and the wider industry.

  • Growth Marketing: Develop and test new ways to generate awareness, inbound demand and talent. Come up with experiments, launch them quickly and measure whether they actually move the numbers.

  • SEO, AI Visibility & Website: Help grow Mercura's organic presence across Google and AI search. Work with experienced external experts on SEO, AI visibility, website structure, conversion and design — and turn their recommendations into execution.

  • Events: Build memorable events for both customers and talent — from recruiting events and community formats to intimate dinners with CEOs and strategic prospects. Own everything from the initial idea and guest list to invitations and execution.

  • Brand & Content: Create landing pages, customer stories, campaigns, event concepts and other assets that make Mercura stand out and explain why what we are building matters.

  • New Initiatives: Spot opportunities we haven't thought of yet. If you believe a campaign, partnership, event or completely different idea could create meaningful impact, you will have the freedom to make it happen.

What we’re looking for

Skills & Experience

  • You have already gained hands-on marketing experience — for example at a startup, through an internship, your own project, student initiative or company.

  • You can write exceptionally well and understand what makes people stop, read and take action.

  • You have a strong instinct for content, positioning and what makes a company or person interesting.

  • You combine creativity with commercial thinking. You care about reach, qualified leads, great applicants and actual outcomes, not just producing content.

  • You are comfortable using AI tools and learn new tools extremely quickly.

  • You take full ownership. If something needs to happen, you figure out how to make it happen rather than waiting for instructions.

  • Your German is C2/native-level. This is a hard requirement. You are also a strong professional communicator in English.

Personality & Commitment

  • You’re entrepreneurial, ambitious and highly proactive.

  • You have strong drive and hold yourself to a high standard.

  • You enjoy starting with a blank page and turning an idea into something real.

  • You are creative, but equally comfortable with execution and the unglamorous details required to make something successful.

  • You are highly organized and can run several initiatives simultaneously without losing speed.

  • You care about results and naturally ask: Did this actually work? How can we make it better?

  • You want to work in person in Munich and thrive in an environment with significantly higher intensity and ownership than a typical 9–5 internship.

Availability

  • You are available for a minimum 4-month full-time internship.

  • Ideally, you are in the final semester of your Bachelor's or Master's degree, or have recently graduated.

  • We are explicitly looking for people who could imagine staying at Mercura afterwards. If there is a strong mutual fit, there is an opportunity to transition into a full-time role.

Why Mercura

  • Learn how to build a company: You’ll work close to the founders and see how decisions are made across growth, product, sales, hiring and company building — while owning projects yourself.

  • Real ownership: You won’t just support marketing. You will own initiatives end-to-end and have the freedom to propose and build things that don't exist yet.

  • An unusually steep learning curve: You’ll work across content, growth, brand, events, SEO, AI visibility and operations rather than spending months on one narrow internship project.

  • Exceptional people around you: Work alongside experienced operators, ex-founders, engineers and top graduates from companies and universities such as Google, Bain, MIT, TUM, Harvard, CDTM and Cambridge.

  • Build something with real-world impact: Mercura brings modern AI into industries that still rely heavily on emails, PDFs, phone calls and manual ERP processes.

  • Tools without bureaucracy: Get access to the AI, marketing and productivity tools you need to do great work, as well as expert support where it helps you move faster.

  • The everyday: Free team dinners, UrbanSportsClub membership, team workouts and support relocating to Munich.

About the process

Step 1: Intro Call
A short conversation to get to know each other and tell you more about Mercura and the role.

Step 2: Practical Marketing Case
A practical exercise around a real Mercura marketing challenge. We care much more about how you think, create and execute than theoretical marketing knowledge.

Step 3: Onsite
Spend time with us in our Munich office, meet the team and get a feeling for how we work.

Step 4: Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we'll make you an offer.

About the Founders

We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean, the co-founders of Mercura.

We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible.

Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility.

Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI.
Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs.

Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences.

Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations.
Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry.

At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins.

Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others.

title: Director of Corporate Development
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Opportunity

This is not a traditional Corporate Development role.

As Director of Corporate Development, you will work directly with the CEO and take responsibility for building Andercore's M&A engine from the ground up. You will help define our roll-up strategy, identify and approach acquisition targets, develop investment cases and execute transactions end-to-end. At the same time, you will work closely with our technology and operating teams to answer the question at the heart of our strategy:

How can we acquire traditional industrial businesses and use technology and AI to make them dramatically better?

This means thinking beyond financial engineering and traditional buy-and-build.

You will help identify where AI, automation, centralized procurement, data, pricing, sales productivity, working-capital optimization and shared infrastructure can fundamentally improve the economics of acquired businesses.

Your mandate is ultimately to build a repeatable acquisition and value-creation machine capable of executing multiple transactions every year.

What You Will Own

M&A & Roll-Up Strategy

  • Take Andercore's acquisition and consolidation strategy across Europe to the next level.

  • Identify attractive verticals, geographies and acquisition archetypes.

  • Build market maps and identify highly fragmented markets suitable for consolidation.

  • Develop the financial and strategic logic behind our roll-up thesis.

  • Determine where Andercore's technology and AI capabilities can create disproportionate value after acquisition.

  • Build a multi-year acquisition roadmap together with the CEO and Board.

Proprietary Deal Origination

  • Build and continuously develop a proprietary pipeline of acquisition opportunities.

  • Identify and directly approach founders and owners of attractive businesses.

  • Build trusted relationships with entrepreneurs, often long before they consider selling.

  • Develop systematic, data-driven sourcing approaches.

  • Build relationships with investment banks, M&A boutiques, advisers and other intermediaries.

We expect proprietary sourcing to become a core competitive advantage of Andercore's M&A strategy.

Deal Execution

Own transactions from first conversation through closing:

  • Initial assessment and strategic fit

  • Financial analysis and valuation

  • Investment cases

  • Deal structuring

  • LOIs

  • Negotiation

  • Commercial, financial, tax and legal due diligence

  • Financing

  • Board and shareholder materials

  • Signing and closing

You will coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisers while remaining personally accountable for moving transactions forward.

AI-Driven Value Creation

Our ambition is not simply to acquire businesses. It is to transform them.

Together with Andercore's technology and operating teams, you will identify opportunities to apply AI, automation and our central platform across areas such as:

  • Sales productivity and customer intelligence

  • Pricing and margin optimization

  • Procurement

  • Supplier management

  • Customer service

  • Finance and administration

  • Working capital

  • Logistics and fulfilment

  • Data and reporting

You will incorporate these opportunities into acquisition theses and quantify their potential impact before we invest.

Integration & Portfolio Value Creation

  • Develop Day-1 and 100-day plans before closing.

  • Translate investment theses into measurable operational initiatives.

  • Define integration priorities together with functional leaders.

  • Track acquisition performance against the original investment case.

  • Identify additional opportunities for technology deployment, synergies and operational improvement.

The objective is not necessarily to integrate everything immediately. It is to determine what should be centralized, what should remain entrepreneurial and where Andercore's platform creates the greatest advantage.

Build the M&A Machine

You will build the infrastructure required to turn acquisitions into a repeatable capability using the latest AI stack:

  • M&A playbook

  • Target database and pipeline

  • Valuation frameworks

  • Investment committee processes

  • Due diligence standards

  • Deal documentation

  • Integration playbooks

  • Portfolio reporting

  • Value-creation tracking

As our acquisition pace increases, you will build and lead a dedicated Corporate Development team.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for an exceptional investor and operator. The strongest candidates will likely come from:

  • Leading Private Equity funds, particularly buy-and-build or mid-market investing

  • Top-tier Investment Banking / M&A

  • Corporate Development at a highly acquisitive company

  • A combination of Investment Banking and Private Equity

You will likely bring 5–10 years of relevant experience, including meaningful exposure to transactions.

Experience in industrial distribution, business services, industrial technology or fragmented-market consolidation is particularly valuable.

You combine:

  • Exceptional financial and analytical capabilities

  • Strong commercial judgment

  • Deep understanding of M&A

  • Excellent negotiation skills

  • Entrepreneurial instinct

  • High ownership and execution intensity

  • Ability to build relationships with entrepreneurs and business owners

  • Intellectual curiosity around AI and technology

You do not need to be an AI engineer.

But you should be deeply interested in understanding how AI changes businesses, cost structures and competitive advantages — and how those changes can create entirely new acquisition strategies.

German and English fluency are highly preferred.

Who You Are

  • You think like an investor but operate like an entrepreneur.

  • You enjoy understanding businesses quickly and identifying what makes them valuable.

  • You are comfortable calling a founder yourself, building the model yourself, negotiating an LOI and presenting the investment case to the Board.

  • You don't need an established process around you. You build the process.

  • You combine analytical rigor with speed and pragmatism.

  • And you are excited by the opportunity to help answer one of the most interesting questions emerging in private equity and technology today:

What happens when you combine the traditional power of a roll-up with the transformational potential of AI?

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Established Andercore's M&A and roll-up strategy.

  • Built a substantial proprietary acquisition pipeline.

  • Created a repeatable sourcing and transaction process.

  • Built Andercore's M&A playbook.

  • Developed a clear framework for AI and technology-driven value creation.

  • Led multiple transactions from initial contact through advanced negotiations.

  • Closed our first acquisitions.

  • Established the foundations for executing multiple acquisitions every year.

Over time, you will build Andercore's Corporate Development organization and play a central role in building a new category of European industrial company.

Why Andercore

  • This is an opportunity to build rather than inherit.

  • You will work directly with Andercore's founders, Board and investors and have significant responsibility from day one.

  • You will combine private equity, entrepreneurship, technology and AI in one role.

  • And rather than advising companies or investing from the outside, you will help build the platform itself.

Our ambition is significant:

to create Europe's leading AI-native industrial distribution platform through a combination of organic growth, acquisitions and technology-driven transformation.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Über Nelly

Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen.   • Bottlenecks lösen: Du erkennst operative Engpässe im GTM-System und bringst strukturierte Lösungsvorschläge ein.

Was du mitbringst:

  • Ownership & Selbstständigkeit: Du erkennst Probleme proaktiv und treibst Lösungen zuverlässig und eigenständig voran, ohne Hand-Holding.

  • Strukturiertes Denken: Du kannst Prozesse schnell verstehen, Ineffizienzen erkennen und klar dokumentieren.

  • Verfügbarkeit & Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und bist mindestens 5 Monate verfügbar.

 

Unsere Benefits:

  • Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft, damit Bewegung und Ausgleich nicht zu kurz kommen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Hybrid-Setup

title: Working Student (m/f/d) – Hardware Testing & Validation
description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Working Student (m/f/d) – Hardware Testing & Validation to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

As a Working Student in Hardware Testing, you will support our engineering team in validating and improving robotic components, with a strong focus on mechanical testing and practical investigations. You will help ensure that our systems meet performance and durability requirements through structured testing and analysis.

Your Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute mechanical and hardware-related tests

  • Perform validation experiments such as:

    • Pull tests to verify bonding and gluing strength

    • Impact and stress tests

    • Accuracy and repeatability measurements

  • Set up test rigs and measurement setups

  • Investigate and analyze failures or unexpected behavior

  • Document test procedures, results, and conclusions

  • Collaborate closely with hardware to improve designs

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Currently enrolled student in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Physics, or a related field

  • Strong hands-on mindset and interest in testing and experimentation

  • Structured and analytical way of working

  • Ability to document results clearly and concisely

Nice to have:

  • Experience with mechanical testing methods or lab work

  • Basic understanding of robotics systems

  • Familiarity with measurement tools and test equipment

  • Initial experience with data analysis (e.g. Excel, Python)

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: (Mandatory) Internship Technical Founder's Associate (m/w/d)
description:
About CyFract

We are a deep-tech startup on a mission to fundamentally change how we treat the world's most valuable resource: water. Founded in 2022, we develop a patented uniflow hydrocyclone that removes suspended solids without membranes, consumables or moving parts, at a fraction of the energy conventional systems require. Having completed the UnternehmerTUM Incubator and a €3M project financed by SPRIN-D (German Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation), we successfully deployed two containerized pilot systems and are now entering a validation project with industrial partners. We are now building the team that will carry this from working prototype to industrial standard, and we are looking for the people who want to build it with us.

The Role

As Technical Founder's Associate, you will work directly with the founding team on our core technology. Over the coming months our separation geometry will be tested with pilot partners. You will be one of the people who builds the test setup, runs the measurements, and turns the results into something we can act on. This is not a role where you reproduce something that already works. Parts of what you build will be the first of their kind, and some of them will fail. We are looking for someone who finds that interesting rather than alarming. You will sit close to the founding team and see how an early stage company actually runs: how decisions get made, what gets prioritised and why, and what a founder's week really looks like. Your measurements and your judgement feed directly into those decisions.

Tasks

  • Build, modify and operate our Munich test rig; run and document test series
  • Design and iterate cyclone and guide-vane geometries in CAD and prepare print-ready files
  • 3D print, post-process, assemble and pressure-test prototypes
  • Build out the measurement chain: sensors, data acquisition, evaluation

Requirements

  • Enrolled in environmental engineering, mechanical engineering, process engineering, physics or a related field
  • Hands-on CAD and 3D printing experience
  • Demonstrable build experience: a personal project, workshop time, or study projects
  • Independent working style
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in German and English

What sets you apart

  • Fluid mechanics, ideally with CFD (Ansys Fluent, OpenFOAM, SimScale)
  • Experience with pumps, piping or hydraulic loops
  • Systems-level thinking that connects hardware, measurement and data
  • Experience in water treatment, circular economy or industrial hardware projects

Benefits

Why CyFract?

Water is the only resource with no substitute. There is no alternative to it, and there never will be. Yet we treat it as though it were free: we use it once, contaminate it, and spend enormous amounts of energy trying to make it usable again. That is the problem we work on. We offer you a seat in the room where it gets solved:

Iteration speed. Sketch a geometry in the morning, print it in the afternoon, test it the next day.

You see the whole loop. CAD, print, assembly, measurement chain, data, and the report that goes to our partners.

Direct collaboration with the founders. No layer in between, and ownership of your own components.

Long-term opportunities. Upon successful completion of the project, we may offer you a working student position or a role as Founding Engineer.

This position is open both to students completing a mandatory internship required by their study regulations and to students doing a voluntary internship alongside or between their studies. The work is primarily on-site in Munich-Bogenhausen, with limited home office possible for tasks that allow it.

If you want to build things that have not been built before, send us your motivational letter, your CV, and a one-pager on a past project that shows how you work.

Feuerlöschanlagen – und das für anspruchsvolle Neubau- und Sanierungsprojekte.

Sie arbeiten in einem festen Projektteam gemeinsam mit der Projektleitung und den Fachplanern der Gewerke Heizung, Lüftung und Elektro. Die Projektkoordination übernimmt der Projektleiter, sodass Sie sich auf Ihre fachliche Aufgabe konzentrieren können. Durch eine vorausschauende Personal- und Kapazitätsplanung bleiben unsere Projekte planbar und schaffen den Freiraum für gute Ingenieurarbeit.

Dabei erwartet Sie kein Alltag mit immer gleichen Standardprojekten: Bei BBP bearbeiten Sie unterschiedlichste Bestands- und Neubauprojekte – vom mehrgeschossigen Wohnungsbau über Schulen und Oberstufenzentren bis hin zu Polizeidienststellen, Büro- und Verwaltungsgebäuden.

Seit über 35 Jahren begleiten wir anspruchsvolle Projekte. Rund 75 Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus sechs Fachdisziplinen arbeiten dabei gemeinsam an technischen Lösungen. Was uns auszeichnet, ist eine Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Erfahrene Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure teilen ihr Wissen und unterstützen sich gegenseitig.

Auch Ihre fachliche Entwicklung kommt nicht zu kurz. Wir investieren gezielt in hochwertige Weiterbildungen und ermöglichen unter anderem die Qualifizierung zum zertifizierten Fachplaner bei EIPOS.

Start: ab 01.10.2026 oder sobald Sie bereit sind.

Aufgaben

Sie übernehmen die Fachplanung für Wasser, Abwasser, Gas und trockene Feuerlöschanlagen und begleiten Ihr Gewerk über die relevanten Leistungsphasen hinweg.

Dabei übernehmen Sie unter anderem:

  • Planung der Kostegruppe 410 in den HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1–7,
  • Entwicklung technisch und wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Lösungen,
  • Erstellung von Berechnungen, Planunterlagen, Leistungsverzeichnissen und Kostenermittlungen,
  • Abstimmung mit Behörden, Versorgern und den beteiligten Fachplanern,
  • Kollissionsplanung und Schachtbelegung zu Heizung, Lüftung und Elektro,
  • Begleitung Ihres Gewerks bis zur Vergabe,
  • fachliche Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung der Planung.

Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich, sind aber nie auf sich allein gestellt.

Qualifikation

Sie haben Erfahrung in der Planung von Wasser-, Abwasser- und Gasanlagen und möchten nach einer Einarbeitung eigenständig Projekte bearbeiten.

Idealerweise bringen Sie mit:

  • abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Versorgungstechnik, TGA,
    Energie-/Gebäude-/Umwelttechnik, Maschinenbau oder einer vergleichbaren
    Fachrichtung,
  • alternativ eine technische Ausbildung bzw. Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung,
  • Erfahrung mit den HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1–7,
  • Kenntnisse der VDI 6026 sowie der relevanten technischen Regelwerke und Normen,
  • sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Planungswerkzeugen, idealerweise AutoCAD und liNear,
  • Erfahrung mit AVA-Software,
  • Kenntnisse in Revit sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss,
  • Freude an eigenständiger Planung und fachlichem Austausch.

Nicht jeder Lebenslauf muss zu 100 % passen. Wenn Ihr Schwerpunkt klar in der Sanitärplanung liegt und Sie fachlich etwas bewegen möchten, sprechen Sie uns gerne an.

Benefits

Bei uns sollen Sie gute Projekte bearbeiten und nicht dauerhaft unter
Zeitdruck arbeiten. Deshalb setzen wir auf realistische Projektplanung,
kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt.
Überstunden sind bei uns nicht die Regel.

Außerdem profitieren Sie von:

  • 35 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche. Gemeinsam finden wir das Arbeitszeitmodell, das zu Ihnen und Ihrem Leben passt.
  • flexiblen Arbeitszeiten mit Kernzeit von 9 bis 15 Uhr.
  • Gezielte Investitionen pro Jahr in Ihre fachliche Entwicklung, u.a. mit der Qualifizierung zum zertifizierten Fachplaner bei EIPOS.
  • 30 Tagen Urlaub sowie einem 13. Gehalt bei gutem Geschäftsjahr.
  • bis zu zwei Tagen Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung.

  • Sportangeboten, Massagen und Gesundheitsprävention.
  • klimatisierten Büros, Kantine, Fahrradraum und Duschen.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the UK & Nordics region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant, transformation leader, or senior operator who wants to move from advising on change to building it directly with frontier AI technology.

 

What You Will Do

  • Shape high-impact AI transformations

    • Partner closely with Mistral’s Sales leadership in the UK & Nordics to qualify opportunities, align on account strategy, and drive executive engagement.

    • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify where frontier AI can create material business value.

    • Structure complex opportunities into clear, credible, and executable transformation programs.

    • Translate strategic ambition into delivery roadmaps, success metrics, and operating plans.

    • Help customers make the right trade-offs between ambition, feasibility, speed, and long-term scalability.

    • Act as a senior sponsor on the largest and most complex customer programs, primarily in the UK & Nordics and potentially cross-region as priorities evolve.

    • Ensure delivery quality, executive alignment, and measurable business impact.

    • Anticipate risks, unblock decisions, and help teams navigate ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

    • Bring senior judgment to moments where scope, resources, timelines, or expected value need to be clarified.

  • Build repeatable deployment excellence

    • Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable approaches, playbooks, and patterns.

    • Raise the bar for how AI programs are qualified, framed, delivered, and scaled.

    • Act as a senior relay for the Solutions organization in the region, helping teams adopt shared best practices, adapt them thoughtfully to local market specificities when needed, and strengthen the quality of execution.

    • Work hand in hand with Solutions leadership to connect customer realities, delivery patterns, and field feedback into practical ways of improving how Mistral deploys AI.

    • Help codify what great enterprise AI deployment looks like across industries and use cases.

    • Contribute to a Solutions culture that combines strategic clarity, technical depth, and strong execution.

  • Develop and multiply senior DS impact

    • Coach Deployment Strategists on strategic problem-solving, executive communication, and delivery leadership.

    • Help teams raise the quality of their work on the highest-impact opportunities.

    • Identify capability gaps and contribute to hiring, staffing, and development priorities.

    • Act as a force multiplier across accounts, teams, and regions where your experience can have the highest leverage.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

You are a senior, highly capable professional with strong executive presence, excellent business judgment, and a track record of leading complex strategic or transformation work.

Typical indicators we’re looking for include:

  • 8–10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, AI, enterprise technology, or a similarly demanding environment.

  • Experience operating at Partner, Principal, Engagement Manager, Director, or equivalent level in a top-tier strategy consulting or transformation context.

  • A strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify value, and turn strategy into execution.
